replacements.old_utf8: function applyPersistedCorrections(profile){if(!profile)return false;const key=correctionKey(profile);const rec=key&&CORRECTION_STORE.get(key);if(!rec)return false;let touched=false;if(rec.graduationDate&&(profile.constraints||{}).graduationDate!==rec.graduationDate){profile.constraints=Object.assign({},profile.constraints,{graduationDate:rec.graduationDate});touched=true}for(const ch of rec.changes||[]){const fact2=(profile.facts||[]).find(f=>f.id===ch.fact_id);if(fact2&&fact2.needs_confirmation){applyResolutionToFact(fact2,{to:ch.to},null);touched=true}}if(!(profile.profile_corrections||[]).length)profile.profile_corrections=(rec.audit||[]).slice();if(!profile.resume_sources||profile.resume_sources.status!=="active_new_wins")profile.resume_sources=rec.resume_sources;if(!profile.dependent_state||!profile.dependent_state.rebuilt)rebuildDependents(profile,null);if(touched)bumpFactVersion(profile);return touched}function exportCorrectionStore(){return[...CORRECTION_STORE.values()]}function restoreCorrectionStore(rows){CORRECTION_STORE.clear();for(const r of rows||[])if(r&&r.key)CORRECTION_STORE.set(r.key,r);return CORRECTION_STORE.size}function _resetCorrectionStore(){CORRECTION_STORE.clear()}
